timeline.message:
Fix label conversion for `--experimental_propagate_custom_flag`

Also fix and enable a test in Bazel.
timeline.author: Fabian Meumertzheim

diff.patch:
@@ -96,6 +96,7 @@ public class CoreOptions extends FragmentOptions implements Cloneable {
       name = "experimental_propagate_custom_flag",
       defaultValue = "null",
       allowMultiple = true,
+      converter = CoreOptionConverters.CustomFlagConverter.class,
       documentationCategory = OptionDocumentationCategory.UNDOCUMENTED,
       effectTags = {OptionEffectTag.AFFECTS_OUTPUTS},
       metadataTags = {OptionMetadataTag.EXPERIMENTAL},

timeline.body:
Also fix and enable a test in Bazel.

Fixes #25208
Do you mean "unambiguous canonical form", or is "ambiguous" correct here and I am misunderstanding?

reply.body: I really did mean "ambiguous" since the implementation used `toString()`, but I now changed this to `getUnambiguousCanonicalForm()` for clarity.

timeline.body: Make these constants in the `CustomFlagConverter` class.

reply.body: I made `/...` a constant as it has meaning, but `:__subpackages__` is arbitrary and not used anywhere else, so defining a constant for it may, in my opinion, even hurt readability.

timeline.body: Instead of the `substring` call, use `String.replace`. Any instance of `/...` inside the label is invalid anyway.

reply.body: Wouldn't `//...super_hidden_folder:foo` be a valid label? I can still do this, but I'm not sure it's theoretically correct.
Fair enough, I hope no-one is naming packages like that but it's technically possible, so leave this as-is.

timeline.body: Why does this mention `--define` (also the comment on line 245). It doesn't look like this converter is used except for with `--experimental_propagate_custom_flag`.

reply.body: The option accepts both Starlark flags and `--define`s.

timeline.author: Fabian Meumertzheim

timeline.body: Sorry, I didn't notice the fix here at first. it's really just writing this file? That's not properly isolated between tests?
